response.overview: On a trip to Istanbul in 2000 I selected this location for a kind of double exposure. In front of the Hagia Sofia there was a fountain - I filmed from a static camera point in two parts with different diaphragm aperture. The development was a handmade manual process in two ways. I put the negative exemplar as a direct contact copy over the unexposed high contrast positive material between a plane of glass. The exposure time was a manual experiment - piece by piece I recreate a structure of cognition and a new texture as a homage for this place - -
response.title: Hagia Sofia
